pausePair.alignment: Equal committed component opportunity; unaligned prefixes withhold equality and state differences.
pausePair.randomPolicy: Original seed and addressed RNG retained. Equal seeds do not establish matched draws; inspect resolution and address provenance before attributing choice differences.
pausePair.scope: Component diagnostic comparison, not native scheduler admission or standalone save authentication. Observer equality differs from physical delivery and full state/save equality. Equal resolved estimates differ from equal full belief histories. Candidate availability does not establish action or history necessity; no clinical dependence claim.
